blocks.text: It shall be unlawful for any person to conduct business as a sidewalk vendor without a license having been issued pursuant to this chapter unless the vendor is conducting business at a farmer’s market registered with the Kansas Department of Agriculture. (Ord. 20662 § 6, 6-2-26.)
